# Close wrap, Thu 2026-10-29 (~4:40 PM ET)

1. **Indexes.** S&P 500 −0.3% to 7,720.39, Dow −0.3% to 52,342.56, Nasdaq −1.4% to 26,184.72; first S&P drop in four days, yet most stocks rose and the Russell 2000 gained ~0.8% ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/wall-street-stocks-dow-nasdaq-2c26b0b1bbc3bfab9f3f4b902172f458); [Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/nasdaq-drops-365-points-on-big-alphabet-miss-stock-market-today); [Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/wall-street-slides-as-alphabet-revenue-miss-revives-ai-capex-jitters-4984885)). Comm services and tech worst, healthcare best; semis −2%.
2. **Movers.** GOOGL −12.64% to $283.82, worst day ever ([Exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/GOOGL?date=2026-10-29&view=daily)). CAT −9.3% ([Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/nasdaq-drops-365-points-on-big-alphabet-miss-stock-market-today)). Midday: NOW −25.6%, FTNT −22%, MRVL −11.9%, DDOG −6.3% ([TechCortex](https://techcortex.net/stocks-midday-top-gainers-losers-october-29-2026)); LLY +6%, TXT +15% (beat, FY raise), NCLH +13%, ADT +34% (buyout), SFM −22% ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-midday-adt-googl-cat-lly-cmg.html)). MSFT faded from its open ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/microsoft-shares-retreat-despite-strong-154600230.html)).
3. **Macro.** Q3 GDP 3.4% vs 3.1%; Sep PCE 3.6% y/y, core 3.1% ([BEA](https://www.bea.gov/news/2026/gdp-advance-estimate-3rd-quarter-2026); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/pce-inflation-report-september-2026-.html)). 10y 4.999%, 2y 4.668%; WTI $101.83, Brent $115.08 ([Reuters/Euronext](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/equities-and-bond-yields-dip-ai-jitters-and-economic-data-focus)).
4. **After hours.** AMZN EPS $1.89 vs $1.96, rev $201.94B vs $202.31B, Q4 guide $240–247B; >7% lower AH after −4.25% session ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/amazon-amzn-q3-earnings-report-2026.html); [Amazon IR](https://ir.aboutamazon.com/news-release/news-release-details/2026/Amazon-com-Announces-Third-Quarter-Results/default.aspx)). INTC adj EPS $0.52 vs $0.40 ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/29/intel-intc-q3-earnings-report-2026-.html)). Early AH: TWLO −15%, ILMN −13%, RBLX −11% ([TheStockCatalyst](https://www.thestockcatalyst.com/NasdaqAHEarningsHistoryByDate)).
5. **Tomorrow.** XOM BMO, ECI 8:30. AAPL 11/2 AMC.

## Swing ideas
- **IWM** long, low. Small caps +0.8% and breadth positive while megacap AI names sold. Risk: hot PCE revives hike talk; rotation reverses.
- **TXT** long, low. Beat ($1.76 vs $1.43) and FY raise, ~+15%; logged at close per gap rule. Risk: big gap fades.
